D001.notes: n is the total integer expression λ+1. Positivity is not granted by this definition: H001 and N001 supply it where used.

D002.notes: I is the integer interval 0≤i≤λ, with i locally bound. It is finite even when empty; H001/N001 supply nonemptiness and cardinality n. All family indices and finite-sum conventions are explicit.

D003.notes: X(r)=x^r/r! is defined only for nonnegative integer r over ℂ, with identity at r=0. Factorials there are nonzero. Its representation action is distinguished from its later lattice and characteristic-p realizations; preservation and invertibility are exported in N002/N004.

D004.notes: Y(r)=y^r/r! has the same nonnegative integer domain and characteristic-zero denominator guard as X. Later lattice preservation and reductions are proved claims, not part of this definition.

D005.notes: U_Z is precisely the unital integer subalgebra generated by all X(r),Y(r). This matches problem.md; lattice stability remains the explicit condition H004.

D006.notes: e:I→V is defined by y^i v/i!, with I ensuring i≥0. No basis or nonzero property is assumed here: N001 is the explicit producer of those properties.

D007.notes: R consists of rational fractions with nonzero denominator not divisible by p, with the specified embedding into ℂ. H001 is its explicit guard and is direct in R002–R005; R002/S001 supplies subring closure and denominator units. The definition assumes no PID or rank-one result.

D008.notes: M_R is the scalar-extension R-module R⊗_ℤ M; M is already an additive subgroup and hence a ℤ-module. No image embedding or freeness is granted here. Its R dependency and pure-tensor convention are explicit.

D009.notes: ι_M is the linear extension of balanced multiplication (r,m)↦rm. Additivity and integer balancing give a well-defined map. Image identification is explicitly deferred until injectivity; N002 exports injectivity and is direct in its later consumers.

D010.notes: E_ij is the coordinate operator relative to e. Guard N001 supplies the actual complex basis, ensuring existence and uniqueness by finite coordinate expansion. Every inference using E (R002–R004) directly includes N001; the definition does not assume lattice preservation.

D011.notes: Π is Y(λ)X(λ) with composition order fixed. H001 guards λ≥0 in the divided-power domains and is direct wherever Π is used. Equality with E_λλ is exported by N002, not silently assumed.

D012.notes: J_i is the inverse image of the R-submodule ι_M(M_R) under c↦c e_i. Zero, addition and R-scalar closure follow directly from those linear maps. Nonzeroness, finite generation, equality and rank one are not granted by the definition; they are N003 claims.

D013.notes: J=J_0 is well-defined since H001 gives 0∈I. Its submodule structure is inherited from D012; equality of all coefficient modules, nonzeroness and cyclicity are separately exported in N003. H001 is direct in R003/R004.

D014.notes: V_K=M⊗_ℤ K with the K-action on the second factor is exactly the original reduction for the arbitrary M. Nonzeroness and a basis are not assumed; N004 exports them.

D015.notes: L_K is the scalar extension of the specified integer Chevalley span with its inherited bracket. N002 is the construction guard for bracket closure, direct in R004/R005. This preserves the characteristic-2 Chevalley construction rather than assuming distinct reduced weights.

D016.notes: ρ_K is the explicitly specified induced action on pure tensors, with invariance notation fixed. N002 exports lattice preservation, balanced well-definedness and the Lie action and is a direct input in both consumers. The definition introduces no extra stability assumption.

The irreducibility adjective in H002 is retained even though the argument needs its dimension and commutator clauses. The construction V_K=M⊗_ℤ K, specified Chevalley L_K and induced action are preserved, as is the nonzero conclusion and quantification over every invariant K-subspace. The supplied five-step route is expanded by R001–R005: characteristic-zero string basis, localized arbitrary lattice and matrix units, common coefficient module with a separate rank-one proof and cyclic generator, reduction/base change, and matrix-unit irreducibility. Every factorial index in the exported T formula lies in 0..λ<p. Arbitrary K of characteristic p is retained, with no algebraic-closure condition.
